name: Launch waitlist help
description: Help mode entries for the Launch waitlist plugin.
author: Brett

entries.title: Launch waitlist
entries.text: The AmberX launch site's waitlist in line order and its landing page settings. Everything here also works through the console API, MCP tools and the CLI.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reads the line, the stats and the settings from the site again.

entries.title: Export CSV
entries.text: Downloads everyone on the waitlist as a spreadsheet, in line order, with each person's referral link.

entries.title: Open site
entries.text: Opens the public landing page in a new tab.

entries.title: Invite
entries.text: Lets this person in. They leave the line and everyone behind them moves up.

entries.title: Back in line
entries.text: Puts an invited person back in the line at the place their join date and referrals give them.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Deletes this person from the waitlist. Whoever referred them loses that referral.

entries.title: Landing page
entries.text: The hook, demo video, theme, pricing and waitlist switches of the public page. Saved changes show on the site at once, no deploy needed.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves the landing page settings to the site.

entries.title: Launch waitlist settings
entries.text: Install or remove this plugin. The site address and admin token come from AMBERX_SITE_URL and AMBERX_SITE_ADMIN_TOKEN on the console.

steps.say: This is the AmberX launch waitlist: everyone in line, best referrers first.
Invite people from the top, export the list, or change the landing page below.
